label: V1 Normal
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: WeChat mini program membership level banner background, premium private-club membership identity card style
Primary request: Create a luxurious horizontal membership identity card / VIP privilege card background. It should feel like an exclusive private-club member card, NOT a bank card and NOT a payment card. Keep the elegance and ornate premium visual quality of a luxury banner, but give it a subtle card-like boundary and layered material depth.
Composition/framing: 16:9 horizontal banner, full premium card surface visible, soft rounded rectangle boundary or embossed edge is allowed, left third must remain darker and clean for native Chinese text overlay, right third can contain the decorative emblem/material detail.
Lighting/mood: high-end studio lighting, cinematic reflections, refined and ceremonial, luxurious but not cluttered.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese characters, no logos, no watermark.
Strict constraints: absolutely NO bank chip, NO credit-card chip, NO magnetic stripe, NO card number, NO QR code, NO barcode, NO payment card details. Do not add any payment-card elements. Do not make it look like a bank card.
Avoid: readable text, digits, brand marks, UI mockup, phone frame, app screenshot, plain abstract wallpaper, chip, magnetic stripe, card number.
Tier-specific visual direction: black pearl and soft silver private club membership card, restrained ornate corner engraving, pearl enamel ornament on the right, minimal luxury, dark readable left side.
